# Vendored dependencies

These dependencies are pinned and checked in so CMake builds work offline.

| Dependency | Version | Use | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Catch2](https://github.com/catchorg/Catch2/tree/v2.13.10) | 2.13.10 | C++ tests | Boost Software License 1.0; see catch2/LICENSE.txt |
| [JSON for Modern C++](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.11.3) | 3.11.3 | CLI/API JSON serialization | MIT; see nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT |

Routing, reservation management, assignment (including Hungarian), and the simulation are implemented in this repository. Neither dependency implements simulation algorithms.
